scope: Actual Android API33 editable PlacementMarks Activity on the existing Processing Android renderer. The shared PlacementComposition is staged without modification; motif outlines are submitted as round-capped segment2 sequences, the accepted Android polyline convention. This validates native controls, retained composition, ignored edits while radial, drawing submission, cached PNG transfer, and MediaStore output. It does not claim upstream pixel reproduction, cross-host raster identity, physical-device support, or human usability.

checks: Java CirclePlacements2D bit-exact against frozen vectors
no new frame marker within 1.5s of each ignored tap
no completed-frame advance visible at the next registered frame
saved URI bytes exactly equal acknowledged cached frame-17 PNG
MediaStore row is published image/png under Pictures/Procedurals

after save, a UI-thread delayed observation measures a finite elapsed interval of at least 300ms and rechecks the same snapshot/composition/cached bytes/final counts 17 compositions and 18 completed frames before terminal result

native_checks: all nine actual visible controls are enabled only after the acknowledged frame
all seventeen exact state/settings/version transitions occur through observed Android button centers
motif and palette edits retain the exact PlacementComposition object; every effective geometry edit rebuilds it
seed, budget, minimum, and maximum taps while radial produce no frame, no revision change, and no completed-frame advance
the extended-budget composition keeps the exact 424 accepted prefix of the baseline in binary64
accepted and proposal counts match the registered Java evidence on every frame
submitted segment command counts equal accepted times motif vertex count on every frame
restoration frames are pixel-identical to the baseline; radial-spacing-restored is pixel-identical to radial
ten registered visual PNGs and the final save are opaque nonempty 640x640
only cached acknowledged image bytes are saved; no redraw or composition happens during save
visual_acceptance: Root inspects the ten registered visual PNGs for the retained ring/diamond motifs, palette change, density change, budget extension, seed change, and authored radial bands, without claiming cross-renderer raster identity.
failure_policy: Before a native launch, the executor rejects stale attempt/image artifacts, runs the pure Java fixture preflight, builds one isolated APK, checks source/runtime bindings, then reserves one attempt under the checkout-local render lock while the host holds the shared machine render lease. The total host budget is 2460 seconds: execution/ADB/pulls use the first 2400 seconds, leaving a separately bounded 60 seconds for force-stop cleanup before terminal evidence publication. Any install, launch, ADB, timeout, assertion, cleanup, or process failure consumes that one attempt and preserves evidence. No automatic retry, emulator restart, or second execution is available from this executor.
